events.title: Audit: agent, planner, router and connector catalog still closed
events.what_changed: Re-checked against Perplexity's own help centre and the SPACE announcement: nothing above the sandbox layer has been published.

events.title: SPACE, the sandbox platform behind Computer, is published
events.what_changed: The platform where Computer's sessions execute, with isolated code execution, pause and resume, recovery and session branching, is now public at github.com/perplexityai/SPACE. The agent, the router and the connector catalog are not in the release.

events.title: Automations ship in the product, with no repository
events.what_changed: A Computer task can run on a schedule or on an event in Slack, Gmail, Outlook, Linear or GitHub. The feature lives in Perplexity's product, not in a repository; scheduled runs are kept on the Automations dashboard, no faster than once an hour.

events.title: Agent API adds reusable Profiles, Skills and managed connectors
events.what_changed: A subscriber can declare an agent once and reuse it across applications, but the definition executes inside Perplexity's cloud.

events.title: Portable Computer documented: closed code on your own GPU
events.what_changed: Closed code executing on hardware you own: the orchestrator, planner, scheduler and sandbox run on a DGX Spark or a 24 GB RTX card, with a Pro or Max plan still required.

events.title: Perplexity replaces its sandbox vendor with SPACE
events.what_changed: Stated in the October announcement: SPACE replaced the commercial sandbox vendor and has run every Computer session since. The replacement itself was not a publication.
